where: crates/blaze-surface (the new item layer) and crates/blaze-diagnostics
what: The new item layer had no list of the pinned nightly's language features: what `#![feature(name)]` means was nowhere to read. The only list was the old diagnostics layer's generated table (blaze-diagnostics src/lints/syntax/attrs/features/table/lang.rs), and this tree has deleted that module, so it was read from another checkout's copy.
cost: a search through three crates and a second checkout before the 585 rows could be carried over
cause: the list lived in a lint's private table, not in the layer that owns what a crate root's features are
fix: blaze-surface lang_features (one home, rule 30): the sorted list with LIST_FOR naming rustc 16d1ffac17; a pin bump regenerates it with the toolchain's other facts
